about: SP9: statements run by node-postgres 8.23 (through the 1.1.4 DB host and as plain simple queries) and by the Rust spike client; test/db-wire-sp9.int.test.ts writes the goldens, src-tauri/crates/unimux-db/tests/wire_servers.rs compares. One statement per entry; DML only into sp9_sink so reruns see the same data.
setup: CREATE TABLE sp9_t (id int PRIMARY KEY, n numeric(12,3), f float8, ts timestamptz, iv interval, arr int[], b bytea, j jsonb, t text)
CREATE TABLE sp9_sink (id serial PRIMARY KEY, v text)
DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'sp9_nfkc') THEN DROP ROLE sp9_nfkc; END IF; END $$
CREATE ROLE sp9_nfkc LOGIN PASSWORD 'Ⅸ ﬁ x'
DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'sp9_md5') THEN DROP ROLE sp9_md5; END IF; END $$
CREATE DATABASE sp9_ascii ENCODING 'SQL_ASCII' LC_COLLATE 'C' LC_CTYPE 'C' TEMPLATE template0
asciiSetup: DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE format('CREATE TABLE sp9_ff (%I int, ok text)', convert_from('\xff'::bytea, 'SQL_ASCII')); END $$

queries.sql: SELECT current_setting('TimeZone'), current_setting('DateStyle'), current_setting('IntervalStyle'), current_setting('extra_float_digits'), current_setting('client_encoding'), current_setting('application_name'), current_setting('standard_conforming_strings'), current_setting('bytea_output'), current_setting('default_transaction_read_only')

SELECT interval '1 year 2 months 3 days 04:05:06.789', interval '-1 day', interval '0', make_interval(secs => 0.000001), interval '-1 year -2 mons +3 days -04:05:06', interval '1000000 hours', interval 'P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S'
